text:
laura: Pushing a docs PR with compact 'schema-lite' examples for tool calls + a short SDK snippet: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1289. Can folks skim for link correctness and migration phrasing?
ci-bot: build succeeded :white_check_mark: preview here https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1289
alex: Scanning. One note: your SDK sample references `response.output_schema` but our client exposes `response.schema`. Can we normalize to `response.schema` to avoid confusion?
laura: Ah thanks, I'll update. Also added a micro-section on 'nullable items' but not sure the example matches runtime expectations.
sameer: For nullable items the runtime prefers an explicit anyOf union on items. Example: ```json
{"type":"array","items":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}]}}
```
maria: UX suggestion: show a 1-line fallback for streaming responses in the SDK snippet, otherwise readers hit a runtime surprise. Tiny snippet to copy: ```js
const res = await client.call(...);
if (res.stream) {
  for await (const chunk of res.stream) handle(chunk);
}
```
tim: Product note: add a sentence on when to pick 'schema-lite' vs full JSON Schema (tradeoffs: leniency and token cost vs strict validation). Helpful for migration decisions.
laura: Will add that. Also spotted a stale link pointing to /docs/function-calling — should be canonical /docs/tool-calling. I'll replace.
alex: Heads-up: in examples/ the file is named invoke-snippet.md but links use invoke-snippets.md — rename or fix links.
ci-bot: preview updated :rocket: https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1289?v=2
laura: Pushed fixes for the client property name, link target, and the example filename mismatch. One outstanding: sameer, can you confirm the nullable array wording is safe for the runtime before I merge?
sameer: Pushed a small tweak to the example to use anyOf for objects/null and added a short note about downstream parsers dropping nulls by default. No ML blockers.
maria: Added the streaming fallback line in a follow-up commit.
tim: :thumbsup: LGTM from product.
laura: If nobody objects I'll merge in ~15m. Thanks everyone for the rapid turn. Feel free to add micro-edits to the PR while it's open.
ci-bot: merge queued by laura.
